# Column definitions (exactly as used for the published chi^2 in fig2_table2.py):
#   r_kpc         = R_REF                                              [kpc]
#   gbar_si       = GN*Msol*MGAS         / (R_REF*kpc)^2               [m/s^2]  (gas-only baryonic Newtonian)
#   gobs_si       = GN*Msol*(M_DM+MGAS)  / (R_REF*kpc)^2               [m/s^2]  (total hydrostatic accel.)
#   sigma_gobs_si = (obs_HI - obs_LO)/2                                [m/s^2]
#       obs_HI = GN*Msol*(M_DM_HI+MGAS_HI)/(R_IN *kpc)^2 ; obs_LO = GN*Msol*(M_DM_LO+MGAS_LO)/(R_OUT*kpc)^2
#   FITS mass columns MGAS, M_DM (and _HI/_LO) are in solar masses; multiplied by Msol -> kg.
#   Values are already SI (m/s^2): GN[SI]*mass[kg]/radius[m]^2. No further unit rescaling. (a0 = 1.2e-10 m/s^2)
#
# Constants (verbatim from hmg_common.py):
#   c0=3e8 m/s ; Msol=1.9891e30 kg ; GN=6.674e-11 SI ; kpc=3261.8116478174*365*24*3600*c0 m = 3.085935e+19 m
#
